xml_content: yang kha cig phyogs dang rjes 'gro'i tshul gnyis sam phyogs chos dang ldog pa'i tshul gnyis gang yang rung pa rtags kyi mtshan nyid yin no zhes zer ba yang This view is also mentioned in Rigs gter rang 'grel (ID:5564) [CXRAK3IW] X 287,5: yang kha cig phyogs chos rjes 'gro'am phyogs chos dang ldog pa gang yang rung ba'i tshul gnyis par 'dod pa mi rigs te. In sGron me, its author is identified by Glo bo mkhan chen as "Bya dmar ba Byang chub grags", probably "rGya dmar pa Byang chub grags", who was a student of Khyung and Gangs pa she'u, and a teacher of Phywa pa Chos kyi seng ge for Madhyamaka and Nyåya. He is the author of several compendiums and commentaries on PVin. Cf. Roerich (1976:332) and van der Kuijp (1983:60). sGron me quotes the following passage from rGya dmar ba: rjes su 'gro ldog cig gi tshul gnyis yin. mi rigs te | mtshan nyid du mas mtshon bya cig mtshon pa mi 'thad par bshad zin pa'i phyir dang | rjes 'gro khyad par can du ldog pa 'dus shing mthun phyogs la mthong tsam ni 'khrul pa'i phyir ro ||||
